name: Ghoulish Party
source:
﻿
A college student finds himself in a dark, uninhabited forest, being chased after by monsters. After being devoured by a grotesques slender creature, he wakes up to a party—a Ghoulish Day party teeming with good food and cute girls! Turns out the monster thing was all just a VR game. 

Now it's up to him-no, it's up to YOU to decide which girl you want to end up with!

Maybe you'll want to date Miyuki, your childhood friend who you haven't seen for a long time. Or how about Esme, a calm and composed woman of beautiful white hair who cares about everyone... especially you? Or even, would you resist Min, a beautiful gyaru, committed to a toxic boyfriend? Wait, are you sure you would want to pursue a committed woman?

[From [url=https://epschy.itch.io/ghoulish-party]itch.io[/url]]
